verdict.rationale: Gusto ships an official first-party MCP server (mcp.api.gusto.com) explicitly designed for end users to 'access your data housed within Gusto using natural language' via Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor, with OAuth2-scoped access — directly matching the AI-native natural-language operation story. This is separate from the developer-focused Dev Assistant MCP server also documented. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming real-world natural-language usage and breadth of operations supported beyond data access (e.g., running payroll via NL command).
